current_prompt.body:
PROVIDE a valid 4-coloring of the wheel graph W_11 (12 nodes: central hub node 0 connected to each peripheral node 1-11, with peripheral nodes forming a cycle 1-2-3-...-11-1), using colors from the set {1,2,3,4}, such that no two adjacent nodes share the same color.
PROVE that a 3-coloring of the wheel graph W_11 is impossible, by demonstrating that the odd peripheral cycle together with the hub node 0 requires at least four colors.

current_plan.body:
DEFINE the wheel graph W_11 with nodes 0‑11 and edges connecting hub node 0 to each peripheral node and forming a cycle among peripheral nodes.
SELECT the color set {1,2,3,4}.
GENERATE a 4‑coloring assignment for the graph that satisfies all adjacency constraints.
VERIFY that no two adjacent nodes share the same color in the generated assignment.
OUTPUT the 4‑coloring assignment.
CONSTRUCT a proof that a 3‑coloring of W_11 is impossible by analyzing the odd peripheral cycle and the universal adjacency of the hub node, showing that at least four colors are required.
VERIFY that the proof logically establishes the necessity of a fourth color.
OUTPUT the proof of impossibility.
